svg.text: Apply on the pilot and check the application
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
APP01 console and your approved management tool
Follow the existing Windows/RHEL maintenance or PHP rollback class for the selected update. Use
a supported management channel available in your license, not an Intune menu you do not own.
Apply only to the pilot, restart it only if required and check the actual application, network
and endpoint agent. Do not begin a fleet rollout when a pilot check fails.
A Linux EDR extension needs Microsoft’s current supported distro/version/architecture matrix.
AlmaLinux remains the Wazuh path unless the exact distro is explicitly supported; use a
supported Ubuntu/RHEL practice server for a later Microsoft Linux exercise.
Check: The intended change is applied on one supported pilot and real acceptance checks are
